content.title: Create a preceptor account
content.description: An admin creates a preceptor account so that the preceptor can use the service, with account creation reserved exclusively to admins and no other admin responsibility specified.
content.value: Controls access to the preceptor role.
criteria: Only an admin can create preceptor accounts.

content.title: Invite and link an Abhyasi
content.description: A preceptor invites an Abhyasi by email so accepting the invitation creates an account automatically linked to that preceptor or links an existing account to an additional preceptor, allowing the Abhyasi to be linked to multiple preceptors.
content.summary: Invite new or existing Abhyasis into a preceptor relationship.
content.value: Enables controlled access to each preceptor's sittings without duplicating existing accounts.
criteria: Accepting an email invitation creates and links a new Abhyasi account, or links an existing account to the additional preceptor without recreating it.
An Abhyasi may be linked to multiple preceptors and see slots from all of them.

content.title: Plan and publish sitting availability
content.description: A preceptor creates weekly sitting slots with date and AM/PM start time in their own timezone, adjustable duration and capacity, and either all-linked or selected-Abhyasi visibility, can copy last week's plan or add a later slot, and publishes availability with batched announcements for newly visible slots; the owner clarified that duration must be 5–240 minutes and capacity 1–50, with out-of-range values rejected by a validation error.
content.summary: Schedule and announce weekly sitting slots.
content.value: Replaces manual calendar coordination and announces available sittings efficiently.
criteria: Slot dates and AM/PM start times are entered in the preceptor's own timezone; times are stored in UTC.
Slot duration defaults to 45 minutes and is changeable per slot.
Slot capacity defaults to 1 and may exceed 1 for group sittings.
Visibility defaults to all linked Abhyasis, or can be restricted to specifically chosen Abhyasis.
The preceptor can copy the previous week's plan into the current week.
Publishing sends one batched email per eligible Abhyasi listing all newly visible slots, while a single slot added later sends its own announcement.

content.title: Pre-book regular Abhyasis
content.description: A preceptor books specific Abhyasis into a slot in advance for recurring weekly sittings, with each pre-booked Abhyasi receiving the normal booking email and retaining the same cancellation ability as with a self-service booking.
content.value: Reduces repetitive weekly booking work while preserving attendee control.
criteria: A pre-booked Abhyasi receives the normal booking email and can cancel the booking like any other.

content.title: Book a visible sitting
content.description: An Abhyasi browses open slots visible to them across all linked preceptors in their own timezone and instantly books a place without preceptor approval, while concurrent requests cannot take occupancy beyond slot capacity.
content.summary: Self-book available sittings across linked preceptors.
content.value: Provides self-service access to sittings without private coordination or overbooking.
criteria: Only open slots visible to the Abhyasi across all linked preceptors are shown, in the Abhyasi's own timezone.
Booking is instant without preceptor approval.
Concurrent attempts cannot book a slot beyond its capacity.

content.title: Cancel my sitting booking
content.description: An Abhyasi cancels their booking at any time without a cutoff, either through the booking flow or through the reminder's one-click button without logging in, reopening the freed place silently for others without an announcement blast.
content.summary: Give up a booked sitting and free the spot.
content.value: Keeps scarce nonprofit sitting places available when plans change.
criteria: Cancellation has no cutoff; a freed spot silently reopens for others with no announcement email blast.
The reminder offers one-click 'Cancel my booking' without logging in.

content.title: Cancel a booking or sitting slot
content.description: A preceptor cancels any booking on their own slots and chooses whether to keep the slot open to others or delete it entirely, with deletion cancelling all bookings on the slot and cancellation emails subject to the configured email gates.
content.summary: Manage preceptor-initiated cancellations and slot deletion.
content.value: Lets the preceptor release an individual place or withdraw a sitting altogether.
criteria: On cancelling a booking, the preceptor chooses to keep the slot open for others or delete it entirely.
Deleting a slot cancels every booking on it.
Cancellation emails are sent subject to email settings.

content.title: Confirm attendance for a sitting
content.description: An Abhyasi receives a pre-sitting reminder at the preceptor-configured lead time and can respond with the one-click "I'm coming" action without logging in, making their attendance response visible to the preceptor; the owner clarified that this response, rather than the original booking, establishes confirmed status.
content.summary: Respond to a reminder with an attendance confirmation.
content.value: Replaces personal morning check-in messages with a low-friction attendance signal.
criteria: The Abhyasi gets a reminder before the sitting at the preceptor-set lead time (default 8 hours); the preceptor gets no reminder.
The reminder includes one-click 'I'm coming' and 'Cancel my booking' actions that do not require logging in.

content.title: Monitor booking attendance responses
content.description: A preceptor reviews each booking on their dashboard as confirmed, cancelled, or no reply in place of checking in personally; the owner clarified that confirmed requires the Abhyasi's "I'm coming" response and no reply applies before that response even before a reminder is sent or when reminders are disabled.
content.summary: See which attendees have responded or cancelled.
content.value: Saves manual follow-up time and shows which booked places may go unused.
criteria: The dashboard displays each booking as confirmed, cancelled, or no reply.

content.title: Configure sitting email preferences
content.description: A preceptor independently controls which of the four email types are sent for their sittings and which they personally receive, sets reminder lead time in hours, and an Abhyasi controls which types they receive, with every toggle on by default and delivery requiring both the preceptor's send toggle and the recipient's receive toggle; the owner clarified that negative reminder lead times are rejected and zero is allowed.
content.summary: Control sitting email delivery and reminder timing.
content.value: Respects individual notification preferences while preserving preceptor control over outgoing messages.
criteria: The four independently configurable email types are new-slots announcement, booking confirmed, booking cancelled, and reminder; booking confirmations go to both parties, cancellations to affected parties, and reminders only to Abhyasis.
There is no master switch; preceptors control separate sent and personally received lists while Abhyasis control received types.
Delivery requires both the preceptor's send gate and the recipient's receive setting for that type.
All email toggles default to ON.
The preceptor sets reminder lead time in hours, defaulting to 8.
